name: Yandere Simulator: The Prequel
source:
Everything has an origin.

Yandere Simulator: The Prequel - The Visual Novel takes place at the last week of March 2017, one week before the events of the original Yandere Simulator game.

Ayano was a girl who felt nothing in her entire life: She never loved anyone, never had any feelings. She never felt happy, or sad, or angry, depressed... But when she meets a boy named Taro Yamada (Senpai) for the first time, she finally feels happy for the first time in her life, could not stop thinking about him, and falls in love with him.
However, she is not the only one to love him. A lot of girls in Akademi Highschool also have a crush on him. What will she do about this? Will she become a sick girl wanting to kill those girls for her Senpai, or will she finally learn how to be happy somehow? It is all in your hands in Yandere Simulator: The Prequel.

PLAY AS AYANO: For the first time in a Yandere Simulator Visual Novel, play as Ayano Aishi/Yandere-Chan.
THE FULL ORIGIN STORY: Find out Ayano's Story of how she finally became a Yandere and decided to eliminate all her rivals for Senpai, unless you change the entire story...
INTERACT: Talk with characters such as Kokona Haruka, Saki Miyu, Oka Ruto and other characters in The Prequel.
IT IS YOUR CHOICE: You make your own choices in Yandere Simulator: The Prequel. Everything you choose will affect not only what happens later, but also the ending.
TEN CHAPTERS: Being one of the biggest Yandere Simulator Visual Novel, Yandere Simulator: The Prequel has Ten Chapters, set in the last week of March 2017.
FIVE ENDINGS: Your choices through the story will lead you to one of the five endings available.

[From [url=http://gamejolt.com/games/yandere-simulator-the-prequel-the-visual-novel/163781]GameJolt[/url]]
translation:
一切都有起点。

《病娇模拟器：前传》视觉小说版的故事发生在2017年3月的最后一周，也就是原作《病娇模拟器》故事开始前的一周。

绫乃是个从未感受过任何情绪的女孩。她从未爱过谁，也从未有过任何感情。开心、悲伤、愤怒、沮丧……她全都不曾体会。然而，第一次遇见名为山田太郎的男生，也就是“学长”时，她终于在人生中第一次感受到了快乐。她无法停止思念他，并爱上了他。
可是，喜欢他的并不只有她。Akademi高中里还有许多女孩暗恋着他。她会怎么做？她会为了学长，成为一个想杀死这些女孩的病态少女，还是终能以某种方式学会获得幸福？在《病娇模拟器：前传》中，一切都掌握在你手中。

扮演绫乃：你将首次在《病娇模拟器》的视觉小说中，扮演爱诗绫乃，也就是“病娇酱”。
完整的起源故事：了解绫乃如何最终成为病娇，并决定为学长除掉所有情敌——除非你改写整个故事……
互动：在《前传》中，与晴香心菜、Saki Miyu、Oka Ruto及其他角色交谈。
由你选择：在《病娇模拟器：前传》中，由你做出自己的选择。每个选择不仅会影响后续事件，也会影响结局。
十个章节：作为篇幅最长的《病娇模拟器》视觉小说之一，本作共十章，故事发生在2017年3月的最后一周。
五种结局：你在故事中的选择，将通向五种结局之一。

（来源：[url=http://gamejolt.com/games/yandere-simulator-the-prequel-the-visual-novel/163781]GameJolt[/url]）
